text:
A **roasted mushroom pizza** with mozzarella, garlic, thyme, and a little taleggio—plus a **dry sparkling wine**.

Why? Earthy mushrooms and funky cheese bring the depth; bright acidity and bubbles cut through the richness. Basically: cozy pizza, celebratory drink. 🍕🥂

A white pizza with roasted mushrooms, taleggio, garlic, thyme, and a little truffle oil—earthy, funky, crisp-edged, and not drowning in truffle.

I’m drinking a cold, dry cider with it. The acidity and bubbles cut through the rich cheese, while the apple plays nicely with the mushrooms. 🍕🥂

A mushroom, caramelized onion, and spicy Italian sausage pizza—thin crust, with a little hot honey on top. I’m drinking a crisp pilsner with it.

Why: earthy + sweet + spicy is a near-perfect topping combination, and the pilsner cuts through the cheese and sausage without bullying the mushrooms. 🍕🍺

A **spicy soppressata pizza with mushrooms, roasted garlic, and hot honey**—salty, earthy, sweet, and just chaotic enough.

I’m drinking a **cold, crisp pilsner** with it because the bitterness and carbonation cut through the cheese and soppressata, then reset the palate for another reckless slice. 🍕🍺

A mushroom-and-sausage pizza with roasted garlic, caramelized onions, and a little chili oil—savory, earthy, sweet, and just spicy enough.

I’m drinking a crisp pilsner with it because the bitterness and carbonation cut through the cheese and sausage without overpowering the mushrooms. 🍕🍺
